<Subject 1> is the fictional adult woman whose facial identity, bone structure, blonde hair in a tight low bun, rectangular dark-framed glasses, tailored charcoal suit over an open-collar white shirt and black heels all come from <Picture 1>. Slim, about 170 cm.

detailed_description:
A premium automotive commercial on a rooftop parking deck at first light. Anamorphic large-format photography, deep blacks with lifted shadow detail, gentle highlight rolloff, fine 35mm grain, 180-degree shutter, shallow focus. Warm amber key against cool steel-blue shadow, skin kept clean and neutral. Wet-dark concrete holding reflected sky, crisp white bay lines, a solid concrete parapet, slim twin-head light masts, a city skyline low on the horizon. A black saloon with deep liquid paint and chrome catching the light.

[Shot 1] The sun is ahead of the camera, down the deck.
At 00:00.000 the camera is on the concrete a metre behind her, low and tilted up; she fills the right of frame from behind, close.
At 00:01.200 she has walked away into the light, a dark silhouette rimmed in gold, her shadow thrown long back toward the lens; the saloon is side-on across the left of frame, its flank one unbroken highlight.
At 00:03.000 she is mid-deck, still walking away, still short of the car. Flare blooms past her shoulder.
CUT at 00:03.000.

[Shot 2] Longer lens. The sun is ahead and to the left.
At 00:03.000 the camera is off the car's nearside, level with the closed driver's door; she stands at it, the flank running away behind her.
At 00:04.200 the camera is pushing in; reflected sky slides down the door.
At 00:05.500 she reaches for the handle without looking at it -- hand to the chrome, face still lifted into the light, chin up, eyes narrowed. She never looks at the camera.
CUT at 00:05.500.

[Shot 3] Tight on her head and neck, no shoulders in frame. The sun is behind the camera, full on her face.
At 00:05.500 her face is brightly and evenly lit, no shadow across it; she has her eyes squeezed shut against the glare.
At 00:07.000 she opens them to a narrow squint and a small private smile breaks. Her gaze stays off-lens, toward the sun.
At 00:08.000 she holds it, skin luminous, a hard highlight on the rim of her glasses, the city soft and blown out behind her.
CUT at 00:08.000.

[Shot 4] The camera is low on the deck ahead of the car, off its nearside, and does not move at any point. The sun is ahead of the camera, behind the car.
At 00:08.000 the saloon stands still in its bay.
At 00:09.000 its headlights ignite, cold white against the warm backlight.
At 00:09.300 it pulls out and accelerates, sun flaring off the bonnet and along the shoulder line, tyres lifting gold dust.
At 00:10.400 it crosses close past the lens, filling frame, and leaves.
At 00:11.000 the deck is empty: concrete, bay lines, one mast, low sun, still air.

overall_soundscape:
Rooftop wind, distant traffic far below. Heels on concrete. A door handle. An engine catching, then pulling away past camera.
